title: Concept: Yarn plug-n-play linker in use
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a `nodeLinker: pnp` setting, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `nodeLinker: pnp` setting.
